entries.note: The service order is requested: the sender has booked the pickup.
The shipment's waybill is entered, at the same minute as the service order.
The pickup is given to a courier; the parcel is still with the sender.
The courier has picked the parcel up. The last state of a service order.
The parcel leaves the origin branch, a minute after its pickup in the sample; the rail calls this step Salida Delegacion.
The rail's second step, between the pickup and the delivery round.
The parcel reached the destination agency, before its delivery round.
